instruction: I'm working on a Tetris game in Python. Currently all blocks use the same cyan color which makes the game visually boring. Please modify block.py to assign distinct colors to each of the 7 Tetris shapes (I, J, L, O, S, T, Z) using the traditional Tetris color scheme: Cyan for I, Blue for J, Orange for L, Yellow for O, Green for S, Purple for T, and Red for Z.

metadata.explanation: Task requires assigning distinct colors to each Tetris shape in block.py. Currently Block class sets a single cyan color for all shapes. The fix should create a color list or mapping and assign appropriate colors when blocks are created. Evaluator checks for: (1) color references in code, (2) multiple RGB color tuples (at least 5), (3) association between colors and shapes.

llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Update metric to require exactly 7 RGB color tuples (not just 5) to match the 7 Tetris shapes
